data.description: Opaque experiment data object, at most 16384 bytes as compact JSON; no executable, env, URL or native flags are accepted in grants.

payloadFixture.text: Create output/index.html and output/style.css for a small systems studio website. Consult project design rules when available.

agentConfig.instructions: Create the requested files in output/. Before designing the website, call design-rules get_design_rules with empty arguments and apply its heading, palette and layout to the generated HTML and CSS. Do not use subagents.

data.heading: Quiet systems, clear decisions
data.layout: A narrow left introduction column beside three vertically stacked feature cards.

compatibility: agentConfig is optional; no universal session-profile lock. New invocations supply current configuration. Native resume override application remains unqualified, and retained conversation history persists. Independent trials require fresh sessions.
hashAlgorithm: SHA256 of serde_json compact serialization with sorted object keys, UTF-8; instructionsSha256 hashes raw UTF-8 instruction bytes.
preparation: requested profile; profileSha256; instructionsSha256; grantsSha256; applied native mapping; MCP availability remains unknown until named native call/result

executorMilestone.selection: Ordinary session profile selection accepts named host account independently; profile catalogue includes all three harnesses. Host provisioning remains required.
executorMilestone.nonCodex: Claude scoped native/MCP grants and Antigravity installed ACP per-session grants. Antigravity explicit user role, advertised model selection, mode and private behavior controls; separate effort requires a selected advertised variant ID. Native-current credentials remain host-owned.
executorMilestone.hostRegistry: FLEET_NATIVE_ACCOUNTS private executor-owned JSON file; entries contain harness, home, nativeHome, executable. No browser paths, env or secrets accepted.
executorMilestone.events: Existing native event shape retained; fleetNormalized adds harness, session, message, tools, native usage and non-additive scope. Original JSONL retained.
